The scene includes the specified wheat crop and the correct black drip-tape line, creating an appropriate context. A very small gap is observed between the installed drip-tape line and the base of the crop plants (approximately 1-2 cm), which falls under the specified advisory criteria for ordinary line contact.

The sides of the package show only standard printed labels and a blue base band, with no protruding ribbon, strap, or tape tails emerging from the carton.
